title: Ten degree-25 components with exact weight-indexed admission

claims.statement: The explicit product of ten four-field degree-25 cyclic codes, with its fixed radius-five adaptive list decoder, carries 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 124200406922064527/125000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=14262663980 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(8433/250).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), field, orbit count and primitive bound (1), exact weight-indexed child admission (2), and final weighted balance and occupancy (3).
